name: newsletter
title: Newsletter
description: Signup form with double opt-in (signed links, no database) and a provider adapter: Resend, Buttondown or Kit.

env.name: NEWSLETTER_PROVIDER
env.description: Where subscribers are stored: resend, buttondown or kit. Unset in development = log only

env.name: NEWSLETTER_SECRET
env.description: Secret for signing confirmation links (32+ random characters, e.g. `openssl rand -base64 32`)

env.name: RESEND_SEGMENT_ID
env.description: Resend segment that new contacts join (provider=resend)

env.name: KIT_FORM_ID
env.description: Kit form that subscribers are added to (provider=kit)

newsletter.title: Newsletter
newsletter.description: Occasional updates. No spam, unsubscribe any time.
newsletter.checkInboxMessage: Almost there! Check your inbox to confirm your subscription.

postInstall: Drop <NewsletterForm /> anywhere (e.g. inside the newsletter-band section or the footer).
Set NEWSLETTER_PROVIDER + its keys and NEWSLETTER_SECRET for production.
